data.body: 8a31 IMPLEMENTED + PUSHED as Gerrit change 1535. Held-out TDD: implementer (sonnet-4.5) saw only the 3-test happy oracle, hit happy-path GREEN in 1 cycle. My held-out validation of 15 edge/E2E: found + fixed 3 test-harness defects (call_tool returns list[TextContent] not tuple; in-process lib calls needed REBAR_ROOT pinning) under revert-first, and ONE genuine impl gap the oracle grew to cover: the error-guard was sync-only and broke async tools (run_workflow coroutine never awaited) -> added async-aware guard + E8 async oracle (RED-first). Mutation teeth confirmed (break ticket_not_found -> 1 RED; break concurrency -> 3 RED). Migrated 6 existing MCP-contract tests to the new McpEnvelopeError structured-identity contract (adapters._reject, test_mcp._concurrency_cause, file_impact schema test). Rebased on origin/main (was 3 behind) BEFORE push per standing instruction; re-ran lint+typecheck+125 tests GREEN on rebased tree. _mcp_errors.py 112 LOC. Awaiting LLM-Review + Verified on 1535.
